capabilities: Create child, sibling and floating nodes with hotkeys
Auto-layout mindmap nodes in a chosen direction
Navigate between nodes with arrow keys
extras: Installable via BRAT; the Showcase section contains no readable content in the README.
intentEvidence: Make your canvas work like a mindmap.
problem: Obsidian Canvas has no built-in way to build mindmaps, so arranging connected nodes requires manual placement and mouse work.
summary: Canvas enhancement that makes Obsidian Canvas behave like a mindmap with keyboard-driven node creation, auto layout and tree selection.
